words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah begin under the pressure of what was just decreed in 19:21. It is sequential and consequential, so {{ar:حَمَلَتْهُ}} ({{tr:ḥamalat-hu}}) arrives as fulfillment rather than as an independent scene. Because the particle is proclitic, the connector and verb are heard as one forward-moving unit, and its later repetition before {{ar:ٱنتَبَذَتْ}} ({{tr:intabadhat}}) starts a two-step cascade: decree, conception, withdrawal.

words.prose: {{ar:حَمَلَتْهُ}} ({{tr:ḥamalat-hu}}) is a complete perfect verb with a 3fs subject ending and a masculine object suffix. The grammar makes the conception accomplished and definite: Maryam is supplied by inflection, while the announced child remains present as {{ar:ـهُ}} ({{tr:-hu}}), not as a newly named noun. The selected sense is pregnancy, but the {{ar:ح م ل}} ({{tr:ḥ-m-l}}) field of bearing a load or charge remains important because this completed conception immediately turns into withdrawal. The word also becomes a narrative hinge: the same root later marks public carrying in 19:27, while 7:189 and 46:15 show pregnancy with explicit qualifiers that 19:22 leaves to the following withdrawal.

topics.headline: completed conception with definite object

topics.reason: The perfect active verb, feminine subject agreement, and attached masculine object suffix are all explicit in QAC and attachment evidence.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱنتَبَذَتْ}} ({{tr:intabadhat}}) is active Form VIII and perfect, so the verse narrates Maryam as having placed herself apart rather than as being passively cast out. The local frame is intransitive self-withdrawal with {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-hī}}) as complement and {{ar:مَكَانًا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) as the place frame. At the same time, the {{ar:ن ب ذ}} ({{tr:n-b-dh}}) field of casting aside and rejection makes the retreat sharper than neutral seclusion. The fāʾ plus hamzat waṣl lets the action flow in without a hard restart, so the self-withdrawal sounds like the immediate continuation of the completed carrying. The same verb-and-place architecture at 19:16 forms an intra-surah frame: first withdrawal before the annunciation, then withdrawal with the carried child after conception.

topics.headline: Maryam performs the separation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar gives Maryam self-removal as the surface action, not passive expulsion.
topics.reason: The active Form VIII perfect and 3fs inflection identify completed reflexive-like withdrawal with Maryam as recoverable subject.

topics.headline: withdrawal governs companion and place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verb completed by accompaniment/cause and destination rather than by an ordinary direct object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-hī}}) as a prepositional complement and strongly licenses {{ar:مَكَانًا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) as an accusative place expression; object analyses are kept as narrowed role ambiguity.

topics.headline: self-withdrawal carries rejection pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the withdrawal as social rupture and preemptive separation, while the local form still means she withdraws herself.
topics.reason: The root field supports casting away and rejection, but Form VIII and local syntax narrow that pressure into self-withdrawal rather than making Maryam the passive object of rejection.

topics.headline: second Maryam withdrawal

topics.reason: Both 19:16 and 19:22 use the same withdrawal verb with a place expression, making a deliberate same-surah frame.

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bi-hī}}) keeps the same unnamed child in the sentence while changing his grammatical role. In {{ar:حَمَلَتْهُ}} ({{tr:ḥamalat-hu}}) he was the direct object; after bāʾ he becomes the oblique companion, cause, and physically attached referent of the withdrawal. The compact preposition-plus-suffix form avoids renaming him, so the ayah moves from carrying him to withdrawing with or because of him, and only then names the destination as {{ar:مَكَانًا قَصِيًّا}} ({{tr:makānan qaṣiyyā}}).

topics.headline: object becomes companion-cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same unnamed child from conceived object to the reason and companion of withdrawal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the suffix to the prior referent, while the preposition reassigns it from direct object to governed complement.

topics.headline: bāʾ holds with, because of, and attached-to
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the child is not merely mentioned again but is bound to the movement as accompaniment and motive.
topics.reason: The local prepositional complement licenses accompaniment and causal force; spatial attachment is narrowed by the pregnancy context rather than treated as separate travel alongside her.

topics.headline: suffix preserves concealment

topics.headline: pronoun leads into place

words.prose: {{ar:مَكَانًۭا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) turns the second action into a destination scene. Its accusative case ties the place to {{ar:ٱنتَبَذَتْ}} ({{tr:intabadhat}}), and its indefiniteness refuses a named or possessed location. The word selects a concrete place, yet its {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}) background lets that place feel like a new locus where the carried event comes to be outside named society. Paired with {{ar:قَصِيًّا}} ({{tr:qaṣiyyā}}), the repeated accusative tanwīn makes the noun and adjective sound like one concealed destination. The noun also joins Maryam’s withdrawal-place pattern from 19:16 and the surah’s wider concern with marked positions such as 19:57 and 19:75, while k-w-n status formulas in 19:28 and 19:51 are redirected here into location.

topics.headline: unnamed place governed by withdrawal

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support an indefinite accusative place expression governed by the withdrawal clause.

topics.reason: The following adjective agrees with the noun in case and indefiniteness, and the repeated tanwīn cadence binds them as one phrase.

topics.headline: being-root becomes concrete locus

topics.reason: The noun of time/place derives from {{ar:ك و ن}} ({{tr:k-w-n}}), but local syntax narrows the root pressure into a concrete place rather than a verbal existence claim.

topics.headline: place also marks marginal standing

topics.reason: The noun is singular, free, and indefinite, with no idāfa dependent or possessive attachment.

topics.headline: carrying lands in marked place

words.prose: {{ar:قَصِيًّۭا}} ({{tr:qaṣiyyā}}) locks remoteness onto {{ar:مَكَانًۭا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) as its indefinite accusative adjective. The word does not name the place or rank it with a comparative form; it makes remoteness the place’s quality. Because it follows withdrawal and closes the ayah, the adjective carries both geography and social severance: the sequence lands at an unnamed edge. Its doubled yāʾ and tanwīn make the final distance-word linger while matching the indefinite cadence of {{ar:مَكَانًۭا}} ({{tr:makānan}}). Its extremity register can be compared with edge scenes at 8:42, 28:20, and 36:20, while the same {{ar:مَكَان}} ({{tr:makān}}) plus adjective frame at 19:16 brackets Maryam’s movement from eastern withdrawal to remote withdrawal.

topics.headline: remoteness belongs to the place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remoteness modifies the destination, not Maryam as a separate predicate.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with {{ar:مَكَانًۭا}} ({{tr:makānan}}) in case and indefiniteness, so it belongs to the destination phrase.

topics.headline: distance includes severance

topics.reason: The local adjective means remote or far, while the withdrawal context licenses the root field of separation and marginality as narrowed pressure.

topics.headline: plain quality, not ranked comparison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rarity and form choice: the ayah gives remoteness as a property, not a comparative ranking.
topics.reason: QAC marks a qualitative adjective, and the contextual profile marks the exact form as low occurrence.

topics.headline: sequence lands on distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels remoteness as the ayah’s final semantic landing point.
topics.reason: The adjective is postposed after the noun and is the final word of the ayah, so it closes the sequence.

topics.headline: grammar and sound close together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the hidden, remote destination completed by matching indefinite cadence.
topics.reason: The adjective shares the noun’s accusative tanwīn and contains the lengthened final sound noted by the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: edge-language frames the scene

topics.reason: Rows cite concrete q-ṣ-w extremity scenes at 8:42, 28:20, and 36:20; these work as parallels for edge staging, not as replacements for the local adjective.

topics.headline: remote place brackets and anticipates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 19:22 tied backward to 19:16 and forward to the concrete birth-site anchor in 19:23.
topics.reason: The same place-plus-adjective construction appears at 19:16, and 19:23 then concretizes the previously unnamed remote scene.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence فحملته فانتبذت به مكانا قصيا links carrying, accompanied withdrawal, place, and extreme distance.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward carried life becomes an explicit mother-child unit and is moved to the spatial edge; the rapid fa-sequence compresses bodily change into deliberate relocation.

activation_trace.role: The inward burden or fruit supplies literal gestation and begins the bodily-to-spatial transfer.
Turning aside into a separate quarter supplies the deliberate lateral movement of the mother-child unit.
Place as a locus of being gives the transfer a concrete destination.
Distance and the furthest side place that destination at the social and spatial edge.

changed_reading.before: She became pregnant and went somewhere far away.
changed_reading.after: The ayah traces a compressed conversion of inward gestation into an accompanied mother-child relocation to the far edge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حملته can carry both bodily pregnancy and the bearing of an entrusted load, while انتبذت به keeps the carried one with her.
baseline_models.mechanism: The carrier does not merely contain a fetus; she assumes custody of a charge and moves that charge beyond immediate reach, so gestation and guardianship coexist.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted message, obligation, or burden supplies the custodial layer within literal pregnancy.
Withdrawal to one side functions as protective relocation of the entrusted load.
The furthest side supplies separation from immediate interference.

changed_reading.after: She bears a living charge and relocates it into guarded distance; bodily carrying is already an act of custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same withdrawal-and-place construction occurs first as separation from her family toward an eastern place, then returns after الحمل with the child as companion and with distance intensified from orientation to extremity.

activation_trace.role: The first turning aside supplies the earlier movement that 19:22 repeats and intensifies.
The circle of kin and belonging identifies the social boundary crossed in the first withdrawal.
The first named place establishes the spatial template reused in the focus ayah.
Eastern emergence gives the first place an orientation that the later furthest-place description escalates.
The furthest side marks the second withdrawal as the more radical boundary crossing.

structural_cues: 19:16 and 19:22 repeat انتبذت plus مكانا; 19:22 adds به and replaces eastern orientation with maximal distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, kin-separation, eastward orientation, accompaniment, and distance; I infer that the second move ratchets and repurposes the first, while a live alternative is two independent privacy moves.

changed_reading.before: 19:22 reports a single flight to an unspecified remote spot.
changed_reading.after: It is the second and intensified withdrawal: first away from kin, now with the carried child, from an oriented margin to the furthest edge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The entrusted-load branch of حمل is specified by the preceding sequence as a bestowed child made into a visible sign and mercy through an accomplished decree; the private bodily load therefore carries a public function.

activation_trace.role: The entrusted burden supplies a role-bearing layer within Mary's literal pregnancy.
A gift given without exchange supplies the charge's bestowed origin rather than ordinary acquisition.
Making something into a state supplies the child's assigned public function.
The visible sign supplies what the carried charge is to become for others.
Tender mercy qualifies the charge's intended effect rather than leaving it as sheer burden.
Perfecting and executing an act supplies the decree's completed directional force into 19:22.

structural_cues: The promise of a sign and mercy for people immediately precedes the focus ayah's فحملته.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift, assigned sign, mercy, and executed decree; I map those functions onto حمل as entrusted bearing, while the alternative is that they describe only the child's later status and do not color Mary's carrying.

changed_reading.before: Mary privately carries a miraculously conceived child.
changed_reading.after: She carries a bestowed, decreed sign through its hidden bodily phase; pregnancy is also stewardship of a public-purpose charge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence reverses scale: what is light or easy on the divine side crosses 19:22 as حمل and emerges as bodily labor, disturbance, commanded exertion, and downward delivery.

activation_trace.role: Ease and lightness supply the divine-side description against which embodied bearing is measured.
Bearing under exertion supplies the human-side cost activated by the surrounding sequence.
The pregnant body's disturbance in labor externalizes the exertion latent in carrying.
Shaking until movement occurs makes bodily action a required link in provision.
Downward falling supplies the result released by that exertion.

structural_cues: 19:21 says the matter is easy, 19:22 names the carrying, and 19:23-25 unfold labor and required action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine ease followed by bodily disturbance and effort; I supply the contrastive arrow from ease to embodied cost, while the live alternative is that ease concerns creation alone and is not contrasted with Mary's experience.

changed_reading.before: An effortless miracle simply produces a pregnancy.
changed_reading.after: 19:22 is the hinge where effortless decree becomes weight borne in a human body and worked through embodied action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Subsequent vertical and material cues configure the distant place: flow runs below, a palm trunk is available to the body, and ripe fruit descends for gathering. Remoteness becomes a bounded support site rather than empty deprivation.

activation_trace.role: Place as a locus of being anchors the later material arrangement to the focus destination.
A flowing course supplies provision beneath the distant station.
The palm trunk supplies a stable material interface for Mary's action.
Falling downward supplies the delivery path from tree to mother.
Ripe fresh dates supply immediately usable nourishment.
Taking produce from its growth-place completes the station's provision mechanism.

structural_cues: 19:24 repeats beneath, and 19:25 couples Mary's shaking with fruit falling toward her.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, trunk, action, descent, and food; I infer that these make the chosen place function as a provisioned station, while the alternative is that later aid answers distress without characterizing the initial destination.

changed_reading.before: The distant place is an empty scene of isolation.
changed_reading.after: Distance encloses a material support system: water below, a trunk at hand, and ripe food brought down through her action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The outbound carrying of 19:22 is reversed by her return to the people while visibly carrying him. Her speech is withheld, gesture redirects the encounter, and the carried dependent becomes the speaking bearer of news, converting cargo into witness.

activation_trace.role: The initially carried body supplies the dependent cargo whose later role will reverse.
Restraint of the tongue removes Mary's direct verbal defense from the public encounter.
Intelligible speech between parties names the channel explicitly suspended for Mary.
Coming back supplies the return movement that reverses the focus ayah's withdrawal.
The assembled people supply the public destination of the returning carrier.
Visible external carrying repeats the focus root after hidden bodily carrying.
A bodily gesture transfers attention and the burden of response to the child.
The carried child now produces the speech withheld from his carrier.
Delivered news supplies the public message-bearing function of the former cargo.

structural_cues: 19:22 withdraws with him; 19:27 comes with him to her people and repeats حمل; 19:26, 19:29, and 19:30 sequence silence, gesture, and speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite-directed movement, repeated carrying, maternal silence, pointing, and infant speech; I infer a transfer of evidentiary burden from carrier to carried, while the alternative treats the silence and speech as separate wonders.

changed_reading.before: Mary carries a dependent child away from view.
changed_reading.after: 19:22 begins a reversible carrier circuit: she returns him to public view, where the carried child becomes the speaking witness she transports.

context_deltas.mechanism: The uncertain-affiliation branch of حمل is activated when public carrying enters a communal accusation framed through father, mother, and sexual misconduct, then resolves into explicit maternal affiliation and a claim of truth. She carries not only a child but a lineage question into adjudication.

activation_trace.role: The carried child, stranger, or one of uncertain affiliation supplies the latent lineage problem within حملته.
The social collective supplies the forum in which the carried affiliation is challenged.
An extraordinary or shocking matter supplies the community's initial classification of her arrival.
Fatherhood and upbringing supply one side of the pedigree frame used against Mary.
Sexual misconduct supplies the accusation through which unexplained lineage is socially policed.
The mother as origin and nurturer supplies the other side of the pedigree frame.
Filial descent and attribution to a source supply the eventual explicit naming as son of Mary.
Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the closing counterclaim to disputed affiliation.

structural_cues: The child moves from hidden الحمل to public تحمله, then the discourse turns immediately to parental pedigree and later names him as son of Mary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public carrying, communal shock, pedigree language, sexual accusation, maternal naming, and truth; I connect this sequence to حمل's uncertain-affiliation branch, while the alternative leaves that branch as an unused lexical echo.

changed_reading.before: Mary carries a body from pregnancy into public view.
changed_reading.after: She carries a contested affiliation into the community: the child is simultaneously bodily load, lineage case, and eventual truth-claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the castaway-child images are branch-distant from the ordinary syntax; it remains anchored in حملته and انتبذت به because she carries and accompanies him rather than discarding him. Render only as a lexical reversal: the text does not say she abandons the child, but lets the mother-child unit occupy the margin together.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The object pronoun in حملته and the comitative به keep the child with Mary while the two focus roots also contain carried-child and castaway-child branches.

activation_trace.role: The child carried small or of uncertain affiliation supplies the vulnerable marginal-child image.
The castaway child supplies the abandonment possibility that the focus syntax reverses by keeping him with her.

changed_reading.before: Mary retreats after conception without any abandonment motif.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can be heard as a reversal of abandonment: she does not cast the child away but takes marginalization onto the mother-child unit and carries him with her.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain grammatical-spatial activation, not a claim that مكان loses its ordinary locative sense. It remains valid because the packet maps مكان to ك و ن and later repeats being, decree, and كن فيكون; downstream prose should qualify the distant place as also functioning like a localized site of becoming.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مكانا is the focus locus from ك و ن, allowing later verbal occurrences of being and coming-to-be to reactivate the place noun.

activation_trace.role: Place and station derived from being supply the literal location and the bridge to a becoming-site reading.
The occurrence of an accomplished matter supplies temporal realization immediately before the focus place.
Perfecting and executing the act supplies the transition from decree into realized event.
Repeated being and coming-to-be reactivate مكان as a locus where the decreed event becomes present.

changed_reading.before: مكانا قصيا is only a remote coordinate.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be a location, the distant place also reads as the secluded site where decreed becoming is localized in body and event.

strongest_changes: The focus retreat becomes a second, intensified withdrawal rather than a single flight.
Literal الحمل expands into stewardship of a decreed sign and into the carrying of a contested lineage.
The distant place becomes a provisioned transition station, and the outbound carrier route later reverses toward public witness.
Maternal silence and infant speech invert carrier and cargo: the carried child bears the public answer.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's carried-child and castaway-child branches, the repeated withdrawal and carrying constructions, and the مكان/ك و ن recurrence exposed reversals that a purely narrative paraphrase would flatten.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether Mary intends the distance as protection or the sequence only records where events force her remains open.
The castaway-child reversal is a contained branch activation, not an asserted lexical sense of انتبذت here.
The becoming-place reading is a packet-supported morphological resonance and should remain explicitly exploratory.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi mal, otlak, saç ağarması, yağmur ve yaş meyve gibi varlıkların az miktarını; ayrıca güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parçayı anlatır. Dal çerçevesi doğrudur, ancak az miktar bildiren söz öbekleri ile küçük parça bildiren ad kullanımı ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel küçüklük değildir; belirli söz öbeklerinde az miktarı, yalın ad kullanımında ise belirli maddelerden küçük bir parçayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Az miktar anlamı çoğunlukla belirli tamlayıcılı söz öbeklerine bağlıdır; küçük parça anlamındaki yalın ad yüzü bunlarla karıştırılmadan ayrıca korunur.

Az miktar kullanımı mal, otlak, saçtaki aklık, yağmur ve salkımdaki yaş meyve için tanıklanır.
Ad biçimi, güzel kokulu maddelerden küçük bir parça için de kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu nesneyi yastık olarak tanımlar ve adlandırmanın, oturmak için yere atılıp konmasından geldiğini açıklar. Dal çerçevesi hem nesne türünü hem de ayırt edici kullanım biçimini doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım nesneyi adlandıran yalın biçime bağlıdır; genel yastık, genel oturma veya yere serilen her eşya anlamına genişletilmez.

error_profile.preserves: Yerde kullanılan oturma desteği işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesnenin yere atılarak konması biçimini açıkça belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kayıt genel kök anlamı gibi genişletilmemeli, içindeki öğeler birbirinin yerine geçen tek bir sözlük karşılığı sayılmamalı ve yalnız kanıtın verdiği adlandırma sınırı içinde kullanılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kapsam verilen biçim, adlandırma veya özel kullanım sınırıyla bağlıdır; ortak bir yalın anlam ya da üretken genel kullanım varsayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Eldeki dal tek bir kavram tanımlamaz: bir kullanım sahiplerince ihmal edilmiş cılız koyunu, öteki kullanım ise çukurdan çevreye saçılan toprağı adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir kullanım, sahiplerinin bakımsız bıraktığı cılız koyunu adlandırır.
Ayrı bir kullanım, çukur kazılırken çıkarılıp çevreye saçılan toprağı adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tek bir birleşik anlamdan çok sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırmaları gösterir; dal bu kayıtları kontrollü biçimde görünür tutar.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık hem sahiplerince ihmal edilmiş cılız koyunu hem de çukurdan saçılan toprağı aynı ad biçimi altında verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bu karşılık, kanıttaki sınırlı veya biçime bağlı adlandırma kümesini güvenli biçimde etiketler; tek ve birleşik bir sözlük anlamı değildir.

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları, bir şeyi elden atma çekirdeğinden açık ayrışma, özel satış, yana çekilme, az miktar, suda bekletilen meyve içeceği, bırakılmış çocuk ve yere atılan yastık kullanımlarına uzanır. Son dalda ise cılız koyun ile kazı toprağı anlamları ortak kavram oluşturmadan aynı biçimde birleştiği için yapısal ayrım gerekir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini çekirdek kabul eder ve buna olma adları ile geçmiş ya da şimdiki bildirme kullanımlarını bağlar. Pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oluşturma kullanımları aynı dal içinde bağımlı kullanımlar olarak durur; yer, konum ve üstlenme dalları bu çekirdeğin yerine geçirilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçekleşme ve bulunma çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; yer, konum, üstlenme ve boyun eğme ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam hem yalın hem bağlı kullanımlar verdiği için tanım çekirdeği ayrı, bağlı sözleri ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, bir şeyin gerçekleşip bulunur hale gelmesini ve bu olmanın geçmiş ya da şimdiki anda bildirilmesini anlatır. Olma adları, pekiştirme ya da ayırma işlevli bağlı sözler ve bir şeyi oldurup oluşmasını sağlama buna bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin gerçekleşmesi, ortaya çıkması ve bulunur halde olması çekirdektir.
Olma ve oluş adları bu çekirdeğin adlaştırılmış biçimleridir.
Geçmişteki bir durumun haber verilmesi veya şimdiki olmanın bildirilmesi bu alana bağlıdır.
Pekiştirme ve gelen kişiyi kapsam dışı bırakma gibi bağlı söz dizimleri çekirdeğe ek kullanımlardır.
Bir şeyi oldurmak, onun gerçekleşmesini sağlama yönünde ettirgen bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dalı bir şeyin olması, gerçekleşmesi ve hazır bulunması etrafında toplar. Aynı bildirim içinde olma adları, geçmiş ya da şimdiki haber verme, pekiştirme, ayırma ve ettirgen oldurma kullanımları da bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ana odağı deve, koyun ve benzeri hayvanların kulağının ucundan parça kesilmesidir. identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kulağın ucundan parça kesme ve bunun sonucu olan hayvan adlandırmasını merkezde tutar; tırnak kısaltmayı uzantı, sarkık bırakılan kulak yarığını ayrı bir çeşitleme sayar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kulağın ucunu kesme ve ucu kesilmiş hayvanı bildiren biçimler çekirdeği taşır; tırnak kısaltma ile kulak üzerinde yapılan özel işlemler yalnızca verildikleri yapılı kullanımlarla sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir hayvanın kulağının uç bölümünden bir parça kesilip alınır.

Özel bir deve adında kulaktan bir bölüm yarılır, fakat kesilen parça tümüyle çıkarılmayıp sarkık bırakılır.
Tırnakları uçlarından kesip kısaltma anlamı, genel bir uç kesme anlamı değil, belirli bir yapılı kullanım olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar deve kulağının veya kulak ucunun kesilmesini temel işlem olarak verir ve bunu koyuna da uygular. Ucu kesilmiş hayvan adları yanında, kulaktan yarılan parçanın sarkık bırakıldığı özel durum ve tırnakları kesip kısaltma kullanımı da kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Develer sürünün üstün nitelikli ve değerli bireyleri olarak seçilir.

Korunan seçkin develer, güç zamanlarda varlığına güvenilen bir yedek işlevi görür.
Bu develerin seçilme nedeni yüksek süt verimi ve üstün soy niteliğidir.
Üstün nitelikli develeri edinip korumaya ayırma, nesne adlandırmasına bağlı eylemli kullanımdır.
